messages.subject: Analysiing factorial designed experimental data
parts:
Hi there,

I have been using the Msstats package in R version 3.1.0 to compare protein abundances between two conditions. Now I want to compare  the protein abundance in multiple level of variables from a factorial designed experiment, perhaps using ANOVA. I have tried the multiple comparison using the “rbind” function but I think it still compares between two condition? Is there any ways that I can use to do analysis like 2-way  or 3-way ANOVA using MSstats?

messages.author: 701dadf5d5bd3f3b
messages.subject: Re: Analysiing factorial designed experimental data
parts:
Dear Hafiz,

MSstats works with an arbitrary number of conditions, and with both crossed and nested factors. The limitation is that it only implements pairwise comparisons of the conditions (e.g., if you have 3 conditions, you can compare cond1 vs cond2, cond2 vs cond3, and cond1 vs cond3). Global comparisons of all the levels of a condition (e.g. with F-test) are currently not implemented, but this is on our todo list.

Sincerely
Olga
